egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-13

Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian manifold.

  1. Show that the following formula holds for every smooth $1$-form $\eta \in \Omega ^1(M)$:

    \[ d\eta (X,Y) = ( abla _X \eta )(Y) - ( abla _Y \eta )(X). \]

  2. Generalize this to an arbitrary $k$-form $\eta \in \Omega ^k(M)$ as follows:

    \[ d\eta = (-1)^k(k+1)\operatorname {Alt}( abla \eta ), \]

    where $\operatorname {Alt}$ denotes the alternation operator defined in (B.9). [Hint: For each $p \in M$, do the computation in normal coordinates centered at $p$, and note that both sides of the equation are well defined, independently of the choice of coordinates.]

(Used on p. 209.) \end{exercise}
